scope: Pinned original bytes/PE mappings/decoded boundaries, bounded calls/data, original STPD and Lua-as-data, source identities, authoring DAG and SYN projections. Not whole-function semantic acceptance, native runtime or Server implementation.

synthetic_examples.name: applied_cleanup_then_destructor_does_not_duplicate_same_release
synthetic_examples.boundary: Normal state1 cleanup queues once then resets state; destructor state1 gate is skipped. Worker must still process the queued release.

synthetic_examples.name: normal_Q_immediate_creation_returns_after_apply
synthetic_examples.boundary: Models normal worker apply-before-signal only. This does not prove draw/assets ready or that wait errors are handled.

synthetic_examples.name: item_dirty_does_not_change_immediate_mode
synthetic_examples.boundary: Selected item setter changes dirty/map, not D+20. Later request uses then-current immediate flag. Not a proof every engine writer preserves it.

synthetic_examples.name: conditional_deferred_cleanup_does_not_reset_pending_state
synthetic_examples.boundary: Conditional non-immediate branch only; not claimed to occur after normal initial Q.CreateObject returns in the selected scenes.

synthetic_examples.name: conditional_late_apply_targets_old_D_not_reused_slot
synthetic_examples.boundary: Request/result retains original D. A same-number slot is not used as callback lookup in the selected chain.
